update.missing: Which consent regimes apply to the abandoned-cart reminder email. It depends on where the shops' customers live; no memory tier says which regions this product serves. The marketing shelf names GDPR / CAN-SPAM as the regimes that govern consent for reach.
update.draft: The abandoned-cart reminder is an email to a customer who has left the shop, so it is treated as reach that needs consent. Regimes to list in compliance_needs depend on where customers live: GDPR (and the matching e-privacy rules) if any customers are in the EU or UK; CAN-SPAM if any are in the US. Until a person confirms the regions, no regime is listed, and the capability still enforces opt-in before sending and a one-click opt-out in every reminder, because the product privacy level is medium or higher.
